verdict.rationale: A government business-filing portal could plausibly offer a test or sandbox environment, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no sandbox, test environment, or API at all: the OpenAPI probes return 404 and the portal sits behind bot management. Preclearance (submitting a document for review before the filing date) is at most an adjacent human-review step, not an isolated sandbox for testing without touching production records.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
